draft.title: Jev: the AI that doesn't write text hits $7.5B

beats.line: Meet Jev, the AI that never writes text.
beats.tag: Jev: AI with no text output

beats.line: Its maker, TypeSafe AI, is now worth $7.5 billion.
It raised $870 million, led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Sequoia and DCVC joining.
Jev only launched September 15. It's built on a transformer, but it's not a large language model.
It outputs probabilities the company calls calibrated decisions. TypeSafe claims it's much faster and uses far fewer tokens than LLMs.
beats.headline: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B

beats.line: Co-founder Diogo Almeida, a former OpenAI researcher, says human language isn't useful for automation.
beats.name: Diogo Almeida

beats.line: TypeSafe claims a third of Fortune 500 companies already use it.
Would your company swap text AI for this?
